title: Research and implement a realistic curriculum pilot
goal: Audit and research the curriculum, then implement one high-leverage pilot that makes learning tasks materially closer to real Software Engineer work and improves unseen transfer.
nonGoals: Không bulk rewrite toàn bộ mission trước khi pilot có evidence.
Không thêm AI/cloud/account/remote analytics/paid API hoặc persist learner output.
Không tuyên bố causal learning efficacy từ synthetic QA.
Không commit, push, publish hoặc tạo PR.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Audit artifact scores all 12 capability missions and records black-box evidence for written, spoken, technical-reading and pronunciation flows, with facts separated from hypotheses.
Task-owned research answers one material design question using primary or authoritative sources, source log, limitations, facts, inferences and a decision that changes the pilot plan.

One existing mission becomes an implementation-ready and running pilot with realistic artifact, audience, stakes, information gap, observable job deliverable, scaffold fading, focused retry, varied transfer and delayed review.
Pilot preserves cold-attempt/model separation, local-only privacy and fresh-only v3 progress integrity; no response, transcript or audio is persisted or exported.
Focused and full automated checks, lint, production build and black-box desktop/mobile pilot flow pass with fresh evidence.
Affected owner docs and CHANGELOG describe the pilot, measured evidence, limitations and rollout gate without claiming unmeasured learning efficacy.

validationPlan.description: Audit and research artifacts contain the full mission matrix, runtime evidence, source log and pilot decision.
Full automated test suite validates pilot and regressions.
Owner docs and changelog reflect the selected pilot and evidence boundary.
Lint and production build validate source quality and type integration.
validationPlan.command: npm run lint; if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; npm run build

validationPlan.description: Black-box desktop/mobile flow verifies job brief, cold attempt, input selection, feedback, retry, varied transfer, resume and privacy behavior.

evidence.summary: npm test: App.test expected the retired mission title Write an actionable issue update; catalog rendered the new pilot title Write an evidence-safe incident update. All other files shown before the failure passed.
Confirmed stale catalog-title expectation as root cause; App.test now passes 2/2 against the renamed pilot.
Full Vitest suite passed: 18 test files, 82 tests. Includes all 12 capability baseline renders, pronunciation, full written retry/transfer/review, phase isolation, storage and privacy.
Oxlint passed and TypeScript/Vite production build completed successfully (1625 modules).
Owner docs and changelog exist and describe practice contexts, pilot limits and rollout gate without an efficacy claim.

Task-owned audit contains the 12-mission matrix, separated facts/hypotheses and runtime evidence boundary; research contains authoritative source log, limits and the phase-context decision. Multi-flow desktop/mobile black-box remains explicitly pending.

Desktop/mobile browser QA could not complete: the in-app browser transport returned Transport closed on repeated fresh attempts, and the protected shell rejected the isolated Chrome fallback. No manual PASS was claimed.

harnix-check found no code-level blocking defect in schema, generic renderer, content isolation, storage boundary or tests; verdict is not-ready only because the required desktop/mobile black-box gate is unavailable.
